title: Curriculum-architect-style year planner
summary: Drag-and-drop UI over the existing topic-bank and Unit Pack libraries. Teacher drags a topic into 'Week 5' of the year view; the planner emits a calendar-anchored Unit Pack. Persists the plan per (school, year-group, academic-year) so HoDs can collaboratively build a SoW.

in: client/src/pages/YearPlanner.tsx (new, ~600 LoC) — full-page drag-drop UI using @dnd-kit
client/src/lib/yearPlannerSchema.ts (new, ~100 LoC) — { weeks: { isoWeek, topicId, unitPackId? }[], academicYear, yearGroup, schoolId }
server/db/schema.sql — year_plan table (school_id, year_group, academic_year, plan_json, updated_by, updated_at)
client/src/contexts/AppContext.tsx — yearPlans Map + saveYearPlan / loadYearPlan actions
Cross-link to Unit Pack: 'Generate Unit Pack from Week N' button calls existing unitPack.ts
Targeted vitest: schema validation; concurrent-edit conflict resolution (last-write-wins with audit trail)
out: Multi-class merging (one teacher's plan per (year-group, academic-year))
Term/half-term auto-suggestions from spec coverage (deferred — could be a Phase I follow-up)

acceptance_criteria: Calendar shows 38 ISO weeks (Sep-Aug academic year) with school holidays auto-marked from a UK academic-year heuristic + an editable holiday-override list.
Drag a topic chip into a week → updates plan immediately (optimistic), saves to server within 500ms.
'Generate Unit Pack from Week 5-12' produces a Unit Pack via existing unitPack.ts using the topics from those weeks.
Concurrent edits resolved with last-write-wins; audit trail records updated_by/updated_at; UI shows 'Bob updated this 2 minutes ago'.

risk_register.risk: Largest UI build in Phase H — could blow the PR size budget
risk_register.mitigation: If diff exceeds 800 LoC, split into a separate PR-H-B (per PHASE-PLAN.md). FEAT-H2 is independent of all other H rows.
v1 hard-codes school-holiday ISO weeks for 2026/27 + 2027/28; UI shows a 'Override holidays' button that lets admin edit. v2 imports from a public UK academic calendar API.

related: G3 — lesson archetypes (planner could suggest archetypes per week-type)
